name: songwriting-framework
description:
Provides an intermediate-level framework for writing songs including song
structure templates (verse, chorus, bridge, pre-chorus, intro, outro),
lyric development processes (theme narrowing, imagery, rhyme scheme
selection), melody-chord relationship basics, and revision techniques.
Use when the user wants to write a song, develop lyrics, choose a song
structure, or improve an existing song draft. Do NOT use for music theory
fundamentals like scales and intervals (use music-theory-fundamentals),
beginner guitar chords (use guitar-beginner-foundations), or recording
and production (use home-recording-starter).
